Package hadur2.core.adapt

Class Opening

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.adapt.Opening
public final class Opening extends Object
What the opening book decided for one battle, read once from the profile at the first scan (the artifact's "one struct"). Everything after it is live learning.

Built only by OpeningBook.read(hadur2.core.memory.OpponentProfile) (or STRANGER) and immutable. The core applies it at the first scan: the gun choice through the gun controller's setOpening (ADAPT-1), flattenerFirst() and surfPrior() through the movement controller (ADAPT-2), the seeds through a SeedLoader at seedWeight() (ADAPT-3), and distance() as the distance policy's starting target. theirHitRate() and mainGunRating() are kept so the two SeedTrusts can judge the seeds against the evidence they came from (RES-4).
